lessons_that_worked: Using upstream primary file as exact structural source eliminates ambiguity for large LPASS macros.
Register coverage requires importing full upstream define universe, not only prefix renames.
Component probe split with version-aware control/widget selection is mandatory for RX parity.
Clock-provider gate ops and managed pds teardown are load-bearing lifecycle elements.
Final exact include alignment (linux/cleanup.h included) prevents residual include-score loss.
what_did_not_require_fail_closed: Iteration 2 had direct upstream equivalents for all requested transformations; no deferred FAIL_CLOSED items remained.
carry_forward_rules: When upstream target is allowed, prefer deterministic section-for-section upstream convergence over heuristic adaptation.
For macros with codec-version branches, always port version-gated defaults and DAPM tables together.
Use standardized scorer after full-series apply only; do not score intermediate trees.
risk_notes: REGISTER_COVERAGE remained 99.49 (not 100) due two macro flag symbols counted by scorer regex but not part of register define universe.
